name: hugeicons
description: Official Hugeicons plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: hugeicons
plugins.description: Use real Hugeicons icon names instead of guessing them. Connects Claude Code to the Hugeicons MCP server to search 6,000+ icons by meaning, and ships skills that pick the icon library for a project, install the right package, keep one style across the UI and never hand-draw an icon as inline SVG. Works with React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, SolidJS, React Native, Flutter and the web font.
